description:
Refactor the 'Hotels' vertex class in the 'demodb' database to use an embedded object for address data. 

Currently, 'Hotels' has flat properties: 'Street', 'City', and 'Country'. 

Your task is to:
1. Create a new Document class named 'Location' (do not extend V or E) with properties 'Street', 'City', and 'Country' (all Strings).
2. Add a property named 'Address' to the 'Hotels' class of type EMBEDDED, linked to the 'Location' class.
3. Migrate the existing address data for ALL hotels into this new 'Address' embedded field.
4. Once data is verified migrated, remove the old 'Street', 'City', and 'Country' properties from the 'Hotels' class.

Use OrientDB Studio (http://localhost:2480/studio/index.html) with credentials: root / GymAnything123!.
